=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- .claude/hooks/unattended_question_guard.py:~260-270 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `blocked_comment_posted()` accepts ANY successful tool call whose input contains the marker string `<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 -->` anywhere in any field. `_contains_marker()` recursively scans all values in the tool input dict/list, so a `Bash` command like `echo "<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 -->"` or a `git commit -m "<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 -->"` counts as "posting the blocked comment." The hook does not verify the comment was posted to the marker's repo/issue, does not check the tool name, and does not verify the result contains a comment URL. This allows an unattended session to trivially bypass the guard by echoing the marker string, then end its turn on a question without ever notifying the source issue — defeating the hook's entire purpose.
  WHY: A session that hits a §28.C block can run `echo "<!-- ai:claude-blocked:v1 -->"` in Bash (or post a comment to a different repo/issue), and `blocked_comment_posted` returns True, so the Stop is allowed. The source issue never gets the `ai:claude-blocked` comment, and the project stalls silently — the exact failure mode the hook was built to prevent.
- tests/test_unattended_question_guard.py:~365-375 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: This test posts a comment to `repos/o/r/issues/4911/comments` — a different repo than the marker's `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows#4911` — and asserts the stop is allowed (`assert _evaluate(...) is None`). This encodes the spoofing vulnerability as expected behavior: a comment on any repo counts as the blocked comment. When the #5082 fix lands and `blocked_comment_posted` starts verifying the target repo/issue, this test will fail and need to be rewritten. The test also does not require a label write or a comment URL in the result, both of which §28.C requires.
  WHY: The test passes today because the hook accepts any tool call with the marker in its input, but it asserts behavior that is incorrect per the §28.C contract (the comment must be on the source issue, with the label, verified by URL). The test gives false confidence that the hook is working correctly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
